subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Engineers built a small model of an ancient bridge to test how it stood without modern materials.”?
options: Students watched videos of leaves growing without normal gravity.
Students watched engineers test what would happen if one road became bus-only.
Students cleaned the area around the stone and added a sign explaining it.
Students watched as weight was added.
